description: Introduction — welcome, battlefield grid, and the three Progeny.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Welcome Commander, to Tactica: a Space Opera.<page/>Your goal is to conquer this frontier space sector for control of its BISMUTH.<page/>Your task is to build an army, defend your structures, and crush any opposition.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: The battle is fought on a grid of squares. You will need to master positioning, unit interactions, and terrain to win.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Three PROGENY fight for control of the BISMUTH: - The Ertrians - The Virix< - The SentusThe Ertrians Humans slowly colonizing the galaxy. Bismuth powers space travel. The Virix The heat provided by Bismuth supports their breeding grounds and allows for life on hostile planets. The Sentus A religious monarchy. Proximity to Bismuth provides them their strength, and they become weak as they move further from it.Each faction is unique. It has its own production rules and bonuses.Commander, you will learn about the specifics ofeach progeny soon. First, let's start with universal tactics.
